description: Colophon commemorating the presence in ‘this noble place’ of Elʿazar b. Avraham b. Shānjū Isaiah(?) (שאנגו יזייא) on Sunday, the Eve of Yom Kippur of 5392 A.M. (= October, 1631 CE). Various other names are written between the lines and in the top and bottom margins of the colophon, including Yehuda b. Shush ha-Levi, Yosef ha-Levi, David ha-Levi, Moses ha-Levi, David Duqis, Yaʿaqov […], Mordehai, Eliyya, Ḥalfon b. Moshe, Elʿazer b. Pesaḥ Ashkenazi, Moshe Bālansi, and Avraham Kohen. Some of these names are repeated a number of times. (Information mainly from CUDL.)
description_he: רשימה או טבלה בעברית. מוחזק בספריית קיימברידג'.
